text:
I now have received an explanation from a friend. It could also be important for you:

Many B1-Holders are asked for her T.Z. Be it Job, Bank, Insurance, etc...

Of course they don't have one.

BUT

What was actually mean is: They ask for your Personal ID. In Israel "slang" they say "TZ", but what they mean and need is the *9 digit ID-Number*.

There are B1s (in the passport) that have such a number (I was told), other ones don't have it. My wife did not.

But you might have that number on your B2 visa (or one of the snippets you were given at Ben Gurion). My wife had one on that green snipped.

-> Most likely THIS is the number you were asked for.
